note: Random non-combat encounters. Each choice resolves to one weighted result whose effects are applied. Effect keys: gold, xp, hp, hpPct, essence, shards, item (rarityBias number), fight (true|monsterId), nothing. The AI layer, if enabled, rewrites 'text' fields with fresh flavor but keeps mechanics identical.

events.title: A Wandering Merchant
events.text: A hooded peddler steps from behind a leaning stone, his cart piled with oddments. 'Coin for curiosities?' he rasps.

results.text: You unwrap a surprisingly fine piece of gear.
Inside is nothing but damp straw. Swindled.
He hands you a faintly glowing vial.
You leave the merchant to his muttering.

events.title: An Ancient Shrine
events.text: A moss-eaten altar hums with old power. An offering bowl waits, expectant.

results.text: Warmth floods your limbs. You feel stronger.
The shrine accepts your gift in silence.
The bowl cracks. The power was already spent.
A gentle light mends your wounds.
Nothing answers your prayer.
You wrench free a glittering shard!
The shrine's guardian awakens, furious!

events.title: A Wounded Traveler
events.text: A figure slumps against a rock, clutching a bleeding side. 'Help me... I can pay,' they whisper.

results.text: Grateful, they press coins and a trinket into your hands.
It was a trap! Bandits spring from the brush.
You take what little they have. Their eyes follow you.
They were no easy mark. Steel flashes.
You walk on. The road is cruel.

events.title: Disturbed Earth
events.text: Loose soil and a corner of rotted wood hint at something buried here.

results.text: A strongbox of old coin!
A forgotten weapon, still keen.
A nest of something hungry erupts!
Some things are buried for a reason.

events.title: A Mysterious Well
events.text: A deep well exhales cold air. A bucket dangles on a frayed rope.

choices.label: Toss in a coin and wish (10g)

results.text: Fortune smiles — gold bubbles up from below!
You feel oddly lucky.
Plink. Nothing.
Impossibly pure. You feel restored.
Brackish and foul. Your stomach turns.

events.title: An Abandoned Forge
events.text: A cold smithy stands open to the sky, anvil intact, scrap scattered across the floor.

results.text: You gather usable forge shards.
Rusted junk, all of it.
A smith's old work, abandoned mid-temper.
Squatters. They don't take kindly to guests.

events.title: The Gambler's Ghost
events.text: A translucent figure rattles spectral dice. 'One throw, mortal. Double your purse, or lose half. Care to play?'

results.text: The dice land high. Your coin doubles!
Snake eyes. Half your gold dissolves into mist.
The ghost shrugs and fades.

events.title: A Forked Path
events.text: The trail splits. One way is overgrown and dark; the other, open and worn smooth by traffic.

results.text: Risk rewarded — a hidden trove!
Something was waiting in the dark.
An uneventful but restful walk.
You find a few dropped coins on the road.
